text.p: Swing-N-Slide Corp, which sells do-it-yourself wooden playground equipment, said Friday it closed on the million acquisition of GameTime Inc.
Swing-N-Slide said it paid $27 million in cash and notes for GameTime. It valued the total transaction at about $40.4 million, which includes GameTime's long-term debt.

The transaction was funded through a refinancing of Swing-N-Slide's senior debt, mezzanine financing, a sale of common stock, and bridge financing intended to be refinanced from the proceeds of a rights offering.
GameTime, which makes commercial outdoor playground equipment, was merged into Swing-N-Slide's operating subsidiary.

"The acquisition, which will more than double the size of Swing-N-Slide, creates a more diversified company, combines two industry leaders and provides significant operating and marketing synergy," Richard Mueller, chairman, said in a statement.

For the year ended December 31, GameTime had net sales of $48,900,000. Going forward, GameTime is expected to account for approximately 40 percent of the operating cash flow of the combined companies.
